tagline: 索尼数码单反相机，2012 年发布
description: 索尼于2012年推出的数码单反相机。配备interchangeable, Sony A-mount。快门速度electronically controlled, vertical-traverse, focal-plane Shutter。

specs.取景器: 0.46" SVGA Xtra Fine EVF (2174 dpi) (Electronic viewfinder) (1,440,000 pixels), Diopter Adjustment: -4.0 to +3.0 m-1, Field of View: 100%, 1.04x magnification
specs.闪光灯: Built-in flash, Range: approx. 3' - 15' (1 m - 5 m); Auto, Fill-flash, Slow Sync., Rear Sync., Hi-speed sync., Red-eye reduction (on/off selectable for Autoflash and fill-flash mode), Wireless;
specs.存储: Memory Stick PRO Duo™, Memory Stick PRO-HG Duo™, SD memory card, SDHC memory card, SDXC memory card
